title: H01: reconstruction of one cubic millimeter of human cerebral cortex
summary: A sample of about 1 mm³ of human cortex was imaged at 4 nm across about 5,300 sections and automatically reconstructed: 1.4 petabytes, tens of thousands of neurons, 130 million annotated synapses, and 104 manually corrected cells. The sample is about one-millionth of a brain; reconstruction is imperfect and initial findings are preliminary.
ai_technology: Automated segmentation of electron microscopy images

evidence.tested: The automated reconstruction was checked by manual proofreading of about 104 cells; the abstract says connections were validated.
evidence.unknown: Automated reconstruction is imperfect, the sample is about one-millionth of a brain, and findings are preliminary.
evidence.ai_role: Automated machine-learning pipeline reconstructed neurons and synapses from electron microscopy images.
